svg.title: FIG-16 Current I/O assembly and execution Software mechanisms; exact mode status stays in the ledger
svg.desc: Build time: one authored assembly; Authored TOML; Reviewed SoC modes and Board routes; Strict resolver Resource / trigger / DMA / stream plans; Immutable typed IR; Atomic generated bundle; CMake: sole software target graph; selects modes and capacities; constrains legal combinations; publishes validated facts; generates selected objects; provides configuration and sources; Runtime: caller-owned progress and lifetime; External application Scheduling / shutdown owner; Typed factory Existing static identity only; Immutable typed face Shared ops + instance context; Public platform lifecycle nx_platform_start / stop; Selected provider Private state and controller owner; Optional traits / stream profiles Read-only selected facts; Optional typed SPI executor Existing bounded BusOwner; Optional vector / service cycle probe Raw modulo only; elapsed unknown; Optional cold silicon preflight Explicit source and immutable policy; Optional timestamp facts Domain / epoch / rate / uncertainty; looks up a typed identity; returns an existing reference; calls I/O and service after startup; ops(context, ...); explicit start / stop calls; initializes / drains private state; optionally inspects selected facts; explicit submit / service; calls the same enhanced face; explicit service wrapper / Task snapshot; cold call / copied admission result; paired facts / same-domain elapsed result; Selected controller / IRQ / DMA; Explicit silicon identity source; emits lookup code; emits immutable faces; emits private instance state; emits lifecycle glue; emits only when selected; emits selected vector sidecar / hooks; selects and links implementation; provider configures / IRQ reports facts; performs one bounded read
